extracted.name: Espresso Martini
extracted.description: This classic espresso martini recipe is easy to make at home! Rich, smooth, and frothy, this coffee cocktail is great for brunch, happy hour, or as an after-dinner drink.
instruction_lines: Place the vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso or cold brew, and simple syrup in a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, ideally a coupe glass or martini glass.
Garnish with coffee beans and serve.
categories: How to make an espresso martini
